title: Different Corpora, Different Skills? A Paired Study of Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models are often trained under tight data budgets, where the choice of pretraining corpus may matter as much as model size or training recipe. We compare two contrasting corpora at matched 10-million- and 37-million-word budgets: the 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica and the BabyLM 2026 strict pretraining corpus. For each corpus, we train teacher models, distilled 58-million-parameter Baby-Llama students, and no-distillation student ablations, using the same model families, training recipes, and evaluation protocol across corpora. Across BLiMP, BLiMP Supplement, EWoK, Entity Tracking, and COMPS, the corpora produce different skill profiles rather than a single quality ranking. BabyLM 2026 is consistently stronger on linguistic acceptability benchmarks, while Britannica is often stronger on Entity Tracking, a synthetic state-tracking task. translated_title: 不同语料库，不同技能？小语言模型的配对研究
translated_abstract: 小语言模型通常在紧张的数据预算下训练，此时预训练语料库的选择可能与模型规模或训练配方同等重要。我们在匹配的1000万词和3700万词数据预算下，比较了两个对比鲜明的语料库：1911年《大英百科全书》和BabyLM 2026严格预训练语料库。对于每个语料库，我们分别训练了教师模型、经蒸馏的5800万参数Baby-Llama学生模型，以及无蒸馏的学生消融模型，并在各语料库之间使用相同的模型家族、训练配方和评估协议。在BLiMP、BLiMP Supplement、EWoK、Entity Tracking和COMPS等基准测试中，两个语料库产生的是不同的技能画像，而非单一的质量排名。BabyLM 2026在语言可接受性基准测试上始终表现更强，而《大英百科全书》在Entity Tracking（一项合成的状态追踪任务）上通常表现更优。这种对比在教师模型和学生模型中均存在，且在两种数据预算下都成立，其中最清晰的……
tldr: 该研究在匹配的数据预算下配对比较两种语料库训练的小语言模型，发现不同语料库会产生不同的技能专长而非单一质量排名——BabyLM 2026语料库在语言可接受性上更强，而1911年《大英百科全书》在状态追踪任务上更优。
en_tdlr: This paired study shows that small language models trained on different corpora (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica vs. BabyLM 2026) at matched data budgets develop distinct skill profiles rather than a single quality ranking, with BabyLM consistently stronger on linguistic acceptability and Britannica often stronger on state tracking.
